breakdown.description: The top load is extended onto the notch arc instead of being limited to the two shoulders
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Apply Neumann traction only on the two top straight edge segments outside the notch opening: y = 0.20 with x ∈ [0, 0.45) ∪ (0.55, 1.0]' and 'Apply traction-free conditions on both vertical sides (x = 0 and x = 1) and on the notch arc.' This correctly limits the top load to the two shoulder segments and keeps the notch arc traction-free, matching the ground truth and resolving the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly extended the load onto the notch arc.
